You are implementing REAL code for an isolated UI/UX-redesign sandbox of the Nxeon hosting/VPS/game-server platform. The codebase is at /opt/nxeon-sandbox (a separate git clone from the real production app at /opt/nxeon — completely isolated DB, isolated subdomain https://flow.k9x4rq7wpz2ah6t.nxeon.cloud, fake wallet money only, NXEON_SANDBOX=1). Do NOT touch /opt/nxeon or /opt/nxeon-staging at all — only /opt/nxeon-sandbox.

## Context

The user asked for a ground-up visual redesign of the customer portal — "think multi million dollar ai startup," genuinely new visual language (not a reskin of the current `.card`/`.btn-*` CSS), but using the SAME real brand hues (violet `#6f47f5`, navy scale, cyan `#22d3ee`, blue `#3b82f6` — defined today in `app/globals.css`'s `@theme` block) and continuing the existing hand-drawn-SVG icon convention (there is no icon library anywhere in this codebase — every icon is a custom inline stroke-SVG).

Four mockups were already built and approved as Claude Artifacts (private HTML files) earlier this session, establishing the target visual direction:
- /tmp/claude-0/-root/4f329df3-66ee-49c8-a6c5-615ecf189efc/scratchpad/portal-redesign-shell.html — dashboard shell/nav
- /tmp/claude-0/-root/4f329df3-66ee-49c8-a6c5-615ecf189efc/scratchpad/portal-redesign-wizard.html — VPS deploy wizard
- /tmp/claude-0/-root/4f329df3-66ee-49c8-a6c5-615ecf189efc/scratchpad/portal-redesign-billing.html — billing page
- /tmp/claude-0/-root/4f329df3-66ee-49c8-a6c5-615ecf189efc/scratchpad/portal-redesign-server.html — server detail page

Read all four files in full first. Extract the actual design language: exact color values used (beyond the raw brand tokens — surface/elevation colors, border colors, glow/shadow treatments), the font pairing (Sora + Inter, confirm from the files), spacing/radius scale, the floating-glow active-nav-item treatment, the ambient gradient-blob background technique, card/surface elevation language, motion/transition patterns.

Also read /root/.claude/plans/validated-napping-possum.md for the full approved plan and ground-truth notes about the current codebase (nav structure at app/dashboard/layout.tsx:33-96, icon system at components/portal/Shell.tsx:182, the 6-way duplicated Stepper component, existing `?tab=` pattern in app/dashboard/settings/page.tsx).

## Your job: build the FOUNDATION only (not full pages yet — other agents will build on what you create)

This is being done in a strict order because everything else depends on this layer. Build:

1. **New design tokens in `app/globals.css`** — ADD a new set of tokens (don't delete the existing `@theme` brand hue tokens — VPS/hosting/domain pricing pages etc. still reference them until migrated) for the new visual system: new surface/elevation color scale, new border/glow colors, new spacing scale if the mockups use one beyond Tailwind defaults, new font-family tokens for Sora+Inter (check if these fonts are already loaded anywhere — if not, add them via `next/font/google` in the root layout, not a `<link>` tag, matching Next.js convention). Also add whatever CSS custom properties or utility classes the mockups rely on for the ambient gradient-blob background and floating-glow nav effect, as reusable utilities/classes, not one-off inline styles.

2. **A new shared icon set** — create `components/portal-v2/icons.tsx` (or similar — use your judgment on the exact path, but keep it discoverable) exporting the ~18 new hand-drawn 24×24 stroke SVG icons used in the shell mockup, as React components, named clearly (e.g. `IconOverview`, `IconServers`, `IconBilling`, etc.). Pull the actual path data from the mockup HTML file — don't invent new icon shapes, reuse exactly what was already designed and approved in the mockup.

3. **A new unified `<Stepper>` component** — create `components/portal-v2/Stepper.tsx`. This replaces the 6 currently-duplicated stepper implementations (`DeployWizard.tsx`, `HostingDeployWizard.tsx`, `GameDeployWizard.tsx`, `DomainRegisterWizard.tsx`, `DomainTransferInWizard.tsx`, `MigrationWizard.tsx` — read a couple of these to see the current shape/props each one uses, e.g. `step`/`steps` props, so your new component's props can realistically replace all of them without breaking callers later). Design per the wizard mockup: circular numbered/checkmark badges, animated connector line that fills as steps complete, `variant="default"|"muted"` prop (muted = no gradient sweep/glow, for non-purchase flows like the consolidation tool), responsive collapse to a compact dot-track + "Step N of M" label on mobile (<768px). Do NOT wire it into any wizard yet — that's a follow-up task. Just build the component itself, and write one tiny usage-example/story-like reference (a comment block with example JSX) so the next agent knows how to consume it.

4. **A few core shared primitives the mockups all lean on** — a new `StatCard`/`Surface`/`Badge`-equivalent set of components (`components/portal-v2/primitives.tsx`) implementing the new card/surface elevation language, status-dot-with-icon pattern, and any gauge/sparkline visual language shown in the billing mockup (hand-rolled SVG, no chart library — this codebase's `ROADMAP.md` explicitly forbids adding one). These should be genuinely new components, not the existing `components/ui/primitives.tsx` restyled in place (that file is used by pages not yet being redesigned).

## Constraints

- This is a Next.js 15 (App Router) + TypeScript + Tailwind v4 codebase. Tailwind v4 has NO `tailwind.config.js` — everything is `@theme` custom properties directly in `app/globals.css`. Confirm this before assuming a config file exists.
- Do not modify any existing page or wizard component yet — this task is foundation-only. Other agents (already briefed separately) will wire the new nav/shell, wizard, billing, and server-detail pages using what you build here.
- Do not run `npm run build` in a way that could leave the sandbox's running dev/prod server broken — /opt/nxeon-sandbox is a live-serving isolated app (systemd units `nxeon-sandbox-web`/`nxeon-sandbox-worker`, currently running and healthy). After your changes, run `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` and `npm run build` to confirm nothing is broken, but do NOT restart the systemd services yourself — just confirm the build succeeds. Someone else will restart/redeploy once all the page-level agents are done.
- Keep the existing `.card`/`.btn-*`/`.glass` classes and everything that currently uses them completely untouched and working — you're adding a new, parallel system, not replacing the old one in place (the old one is still used by ~54 unredesigned pages).
- No icon library, no chart library, no CSS framework beyond what's already here (Tailwind v4). Match the codebase's existing discipline of zero non-brand-approved external dependencies.
- Follow the existing code style: no unnecessary comments, but DO keep comments that explain non-obvious WHY (matching this codebase's own heavily-commented style where a comment explains a real incident or subtle invariant — see any existing lib/ file for the tone).

## When done

Report back: exact file paths created/modified, a summary of the token names/utility classes you added (so other agents can reference them precisely), the Stepper component's exact prop signature, and confirmation that `tsc --noEmit` and `npm run build` both pass cleanly in /opt/nxeon-sandbox.

## Summary

Built the foundation layer for the portal v2 redesign in `/opt/nxeon-sandbox`. Both `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` and `npm run build` pass cleanly (exit code 0, full route manifest generated, no errors). No existing pages/wizards were touched; the old `.card`/`.btn-*`/`.glass` system is untouched and still compiles. Systemd services were not restarted.

### Files created
- `/opt/nxeon-sandbox/components/portal-v2/icons.tsx` — 30 hand-drawn 24×24 stroke icon components, path data pulled verbatim from the approved mockups (24 from the shell mockup's nav/UI icon map, plus `IconMonitor`, `IconLock`, `IconShield`, `IconArrowRight`, `IconRefresh`, `IconTerminal` from the wizard/server-detail mockups). Each is a real named React component (e.g. `IconOverview`, `IconServers`, `IconWallet`, `IconShieldCheck`).
- `/opt/nxeon-sandbox/components/portal-v2/Stepper.tsx` — the unified stepper. Signature:
  ```ts
  export function Stepper({ currentStep, steps, variant = "default", className = "" }: {
    currentStep: number;
    steps: (string | { label: string; description?: string })[];
    variant?: "default" | "muted";
    className?: string;
  })
  ```
  Shaped as a drop-in for all 6 existing duplicated steppers (`currentStep`/`steps` map onto every current call site's `step`/`steps`). Circular badges → checkmark on completion, connector line that visually fills via a width transition, `default` = brand gradient/glow, `muted` = flat neutral (for Migration/Transfer-style flows). Collapses below `md` (768px) to a dot-track + "Step N of M" + current label. Not wired into any wizard yet, per instructions — includes a usage-example comment block.
- `/opt/nxeon-sandbox/components/portal-v2/primitives.tsx` — `Surface`/`Surface elevated`, `IconTile` (tone: violet/cyan/green/blue), `Pill`, `StatusPill` (tone: brand/good/warn/bad/neutral), `StatCardV2`, `Gauge` (hand-rolled semicircular SVG, billing mockup, dynamic 0–100 value), `BarMeter` (linear meter, brand or warn-gradient tone). All dependency-free SVG/CSS — no chart library, matching `ROADMAP.md`. Existing `components/ui/charts.tsx`'s `Sparkline` is called out in comments as directly reusable rather than duplicated.

### Files modified
